_comment: Trace Browser, Browser page (cards T2, T3b). Drawn by emtk.view_form over TraceBrowserModel (gui/model.py); the trace plot and the annotation box are drawn by gui/app.py (a plot cannot be a spec); the Export, CSV, DOCX, Delete and hand-off buttons (card T4) act on the table's selection (one row, or all rows after Select all); Delete asks for a confirmation that gui/app.py draws.
title: Trace browser

sections.description: Go back to the detector setup, open a folder of TTTR files, or clear what the browser holds.

buttons.label: ← Select setup
buttons.description: Go back to the detector setup page. The accepted setup, the folder and the file list stay as they are.

buttons.label: Open
buttons.description: Choose a folder with PTU/TTTR files. You can also drop a folder on the window.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Clear the file list, the selection and the shown trace. No file and no rating or note is changed.

buttons.label: Clear caches
buttons.description: Delete the cached traces and the cached image probes of this folder, in memory and on disk. Traces are computed again when needed.

sections.description: Select files, copy them or their traces out of the folder, write a report, or move them to the .trash folder.

buttons.label: Select all
buttons.description: Select every listed file, so that Export, CSV, DOCX, Delete and the hand-offs work on all of them. Click a row to go back to one file.

buttons.label: Export
buttons.description: Copy the selected files, unchanged, into a folder you choose. Click a row, or Select all, first.

buttons.label: CSV
buttons.description: Write the binned trace of each selected file as a CSV file (time and one column per series, at the current bin window) into a folder you choose.

buttons.label: DOCX
buttons.description: Write a Word report of the selected files (name, folder, rating, annotation, trace picture) into the opened folder. Needs the python-docx package: greyed when it is not installed.

buttons.label: Delete
buttons.description: Move the selected files, and the files that share their name, to the .trash folder of the opened folder after you confirm. Nothing is deleted for good. The Delete key does the same.

sections.description: Open the selected trace in another ChiSurf tool. These need the ChiSurf main window.

buttons.label: HMM
buttons.description: Open the first selected file in Intensity Trace Analysis with the current bin window and setup. Needs the ChiSurf main window: greyed when this app runs on its own.

buttons.label: TW
buttons.description: Open the first selected file in TTTR Time Window with the current bin window. Needs the ChiSurf main window: greyed when this app runs on its own.

buttons.label: NDX
buttons.description: Cut the first selected file into windows of the current bin window, write the burst table beside the data and open it in ndX. Needs the ChiSurf main window: greyed when this app runs on its own.

sections.description: Compute the traces of all listed files in the background, so that selecting a file shows its trace at once.

buttons.label: Precompute
buttons.description: Compute and cache the trace of every listed file in the background, with the current bin window. Selecting a file afterwards shows its trace at once.

buttons.label: Stop
buttons.description: Stop the running precompute after the file it is working on. The traces computed so far stay cached.

sections.label: Precompute after scan
sections.description: Run the precompute automatically after every scan of a folder, as the Qt browser did. Switch it off for big folders if you only look at a few files.

sections.label: Folder
sections.description: The folder whose files are listed. Use Open, or drop a folder on the window.

sections.label: Include subfolders
sections.description: Also list the files in the sub-folders of the opened folder (the .trash folder is never listed). Switching it rescans the folder.

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Show only the files whose rating passes: all, at least 1, 2 or 3 stars, or only unrated files.

sections.label: Bin window [ms]
sections.description: Width of the time bins of the intensity trace in milliseconds. Changing it loads the trace of the selected file again.
The y axis range of the trace plot.

sections.label: Y min
sections.description: Lower limit of the trace plot's y axis (counts per bin). Entered the wrong way round with Y max, the two are swapped.

sections.label: Y max
sections.description: Upper limit of the trace plot's y axis (counts per bin).
How many files were found in the folder and how many pass the filter, or what went wrong.

sections.title: Files
sections.description: One row per listed file. Click a row to select it (Select all selects every row); double click a rating or a note to edit it. Ratings and notes are saved beside the data in the folder's .trace_browser_meta.json.

columns.title: File
columns.description: File name, relative to the opened folder. Click the header to sort.

columns.title: Rating
columns.description: Rating from 0 (unrated) to 3, as the three stars of the Qt tool. Double click, type a whole number and press Enter. Sorting by this column orders by the number.

columns.title: Notes
columns.description: Free text about the file. Double click, type and press Enter; it is saved with the rating.
